headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays) has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers) has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right ankle posterior impingement. Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays) has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 6, 2026, with a right hamstring strain. Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins) has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain. Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right arm fatigue. Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left flexor strain.

Several teams have made notable roster moves. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Miami Marlins also traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in the game.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Impact players for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-handed pitcher Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
